items.title: Steve Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 15, 2017
items.q: That’s Joe Farnsworth playing drums. Yeah. I was like the drummer’s killing. That’s Joe.

ctx.x: You know it’s from the Rochester Jazz Festival.
Oh yeah. That’s Joe Farnsworth playing drums. Yeah. I was like the drummer’s killing. That’s Joe.

Well it’s not that great a recording because it was live, I mean quality-wise, but I wanted to play it for you because the older gentlemen that I’ve interviewed, the fellas that were playing back in the 30s and 40s, they always insisted that you have to find your own sound. They’d say, “Sweets Edison? One note you’d know.” And it’s important. So what makes Steve Davis’s trombone — © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
